en: Fixed conversations failing every request with "text content blocks must be non-empty" when an earlier assistant turn held an empty text block beside other content, including after `--resume`
zh: 修复当较早的 assistant 轮次在其他内容旁包含空文本块时，对话的每个请求都因“text content blocks must be non-empty”而失败的问题，包括在 `--resume` 之后
